subject: Notice: Temporary data processor onboarding - EdgeAgents EU relay
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgeagents.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Cc: EdgeAgents Security <security@edgeagents.io>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: Temporary data processor onboarding - EdgeAgents EU relay

Hi Diego / Kimberly,

Quick heads-up: EdgeAgents needs to onboard a temporary processing relay in the EU to handle a short-term spike in telemetry ingestion for one of our shared customers (internal tracking id: EA-TEMP-114). Scope: ephemeral compute only (inbound telemetry parsing and short-lived indexing), no long-term storage; retention window 72 hours.

Key points:
- Processor: EdgeAgents EU Relay (managed by EdgeAgents ops team)
- Data types: service telemetry (latency, error traces, anonymized request IDs), no PII expected
- Processing window: 2028-06-26 00:00 UTC -> 2028-07-10 23:59 UTC (tentative)
- Location: Frankfurt (DE) region only
- Access controls: audit logs enabled, token-based limited-scoped credentials, KMS-managed encryption for ephemeral artifacts

I've attached: edgeagents-subproc-manifest.xlsx (inventory + team contacts) and a short SOC2 snapshot. We can sign a DPA addendum if needed; Maria Ruiz from our compliance team is looped in and will respond with the technical attachments once you confirm acceptance criteria.

Ask: can Redwood review and approve by EOD 2028-06-27? We realize this is tight — happy to provide more evidence. If helpful, we can also provide a short runbook for the on/off cutover.

Thanks,
Liam
-- 
Liam O'Connor
Head of Operations, EdgeAgents Inc.
liam@edgeagents.io | +44 20 7123 4567
Attachment: edgeagents-subproc-manifest.xlsx, soc2-snapshot.zip

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgeagents.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Temporary data processor onboarding - EdgeAgents EU relay

Liam — thanks for the heads-up and the manifest. A few clarifying questions before we can greenlight: 

1) Encryption & keys: where are production keys stored and who has KMS access? Is there an HSM-backed KMS or are you using cloud-provider KMS?
2) Dataflow: we need a compact dataflow diagram showing ingress, ephemeral storage (if any), and egress. Please mark any third-country egress (outside EU).
3) Role separation: confirm that EdgeAgents will only act as compute/transform and that persistent storage (if any) remains under Redwood custody or is deleted within 72 hours.
4) Debug artifacts: any debug dumps must be pushed to a locked bucket with access logs; can you commit to scrub PII in debug output?
5) Audit evidence: SOC2 snapshot is helpful; we need a link or package that includes the controls mapping and at least the latest report date.

Internal note: CCing Naomi for compliance review and Kimberly for procurement/legal questions. I'm attaching our subproc-review-checklist.xlsx for your convenience — fill the highlighted fields and we can fast-track.

Target timeline: if we get answers + evidence by EOD 6/26 (your timezone), Naomi and I can get an approval path together and loop in Legal for a DPA addendum sign-off. If any of this requires procurement PO or exec approval, please flag it.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Security Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: subproc-review-checklist.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>, Liam O'Connor <liam@edgeagents.io>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Temporary data processor onboarding - EdgeAgents EU relay

Thanks Diego / Liam. I reviewed the manifest briefly. Procurement / Legal will want a short DPA addendum (1-2 pages) that scopes the temporary relay and includes a data residency clause limited to DE-region. I've drafted a minimal addendum and attached it as dpa-addendum-draft.pdf — this is our starting point; happy to take your edits.

Jordan, please prepare a provisional PO template in case this moves forward (small value, 2-week commitment).

Naomi — once you confirm the SOC2 mapping + KMS details Diego requested, we can execute on the addendum and mark the vendor as "provisionally approved" with the following conditions:
- Limited timeframe (no more than 14 days unless extended in writing)
- Audit logging & retention for 90 days (logs only)
- Immediate removal of access at cutover end, with deletion confirmation

Liam — we will need a Docusign link for the addendum and a confirmation that EdgeAgents' staff accessing the environment are on a named-operator list.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Partnerships & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachment: dpa-addendum-draft.pdf

From: Maria Ruiz <maria@edgeagents.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@edgeagents.io>, EdgeAgents Security <security@edgeagents.io>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 13:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Temporary data processor onboarding - EdgeAgents EU relay

Diego / Kimberly — thanks for the rapid review. Answers below (quoting Diego inline):

> 1) Encryption & keys: where are production keys stored and who has KMS access? Is there an HSM-backed KMS or are you using cloud-provider KMS?
We use provider KMS with HSM-backed key material in DE region. Key access is limited to EdgeAgents KMS service account; no human KMS key transits. We will provide the key policy excerpt and IAM bindings (attached in soc2-snapshot.zip).

> 2) Dataflow: we need a compact dataflow diagram showing ingress, ephemeral storage (if any), and egress. Please mark any third-country egress (outside EU).
Uploading a 1-page diagram to the onboarding folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bEdgeAgents/onboarding-playbook (see file: dataflow-eu-relay.png). No egress outside EU in the proposed config.

> 3) Role separation: confirm that EdgeAgents will only act as compute/transform and that persistent storage (if any) remains under Redwood custody or is deleted within 72 hours.
Confirmed. All persistent artifacts are deleted within 72 hours; ephemeral caches are in-memory or ephemeral disks wiped on instance termination.

> 4) Debug artifacts: any debug dumps must be pushed to a locked bucket with access logs; can you commit to scrub PII in debug output?
Yes — debug dumps will be pushed to a locked bucket with object-level ACLs and access logs enabled; PII scrubbing is part of our ingestion pipeline for this customer.

> 5) Audit evidence: SOC2 snapshot is helpful; we need a link or package that includes the controls mapping and at least the latest report date.
SOC2 snapshot (controls mapping + report date 2028-04-15) is in soc2-snapshot.zip attached.

Next steps we propose:
- EdgeAgents will sign the attached dpa-addendum-draft via DocuSign (we'll send the link within 2 hours).
- Provide a named-operator list ahead of cutover (we will send CSV by EOD).
- Provide final confirmation that no egress occurs outside DE region.

I'll attach the final manifest and the dataflow PNG to this thread. If you need anything else we can hop on a quick call late today.

Best,
Maria Ruiz
Compliance Lead, EdgeAgents Inc.
Attachments: edgeagents-subproc-manifest.xlsx (updated), dataflow-eu-relay.png, soc2-snapshot.zip, dpa-addendum-draft.pdf
